title: Construct String With Repeat Limit
goal: Build the lexicographically largest string without exceeding consecutive-repeat limits.
strategy: Use the largest remaining letter up to its allowed run length. If more copies remain, insert the largest available smaller letter as one separator; stop if no separator exists.

A limit of one forbids all equal neighbors
